title: Walkthrough capture mark
description: Input to capture mark --input <file> or --data <JSON>. --id names the stable operation; optional payload id names the retained mark. A target comes from the latest live observation of the selected capture page, with no intervening dispatched action or capture start/stop. Runtime checks observation identity, unchanged viewport and scrolling, visible geometry and screenshot bounds without supplying browser input. Targets do not track moving subjects or establish settlement.

id.description: Optional distinct mark identity; omitted IDs are generated and returned.

settled.description: Request observation of unchanged actual pixels. This establishes neither application success nor whether a pending state may be held editorially.

target.description: Choose an observed reference or a rectangle in that observation's native screenshot pixels. Omit when no particular subject needs framing. Reading a retained observation does not make it current again.

referenceTarget.description: Use a ref from the named current observation. Runtime derives its observed CSS geometry and requires the exact element to remain wholly visible, unclipped and unmoved; marking never scrolls it into view.

screenshotTarget.description: Requires a screenshot in the named current observation. box uses its screenshotPixels dimensions, not CSS or source pixels. Runtime requires x + width <= screenshotPixels.width and y + height <= screenshotPixels.height, then maps the rectangle into canonical source pixels.
